description: codebase-kg hooks. (1) A PreToolUse search gate: a Grep/Glob (or shell grep/rg/find) aimed at mapped code is denied with the instruction to query the code graph first. A graph query clears the next gate_credit searches; a search that already names an anchored file, one aimed outside the repo, one that can only match non-source files (plists, images, Xcode project files), and a repeat of a denied search (the same pattern, however reworded) are all free. (2) A PostToolUse nudge on Edit/Write/MultiEdit that reminds you to run /codebase-kg:refresh when you edit source no node anchors on, and periodically once enough mapped files have changed. Both honor .claude/codebase-kg.local.md (search_gate, gate_credit, gate_shell_search, post_edit_nudge, nudge_every, root, graph_path) and SKIP_KG, and both no-op when the repo has no graph. (3) A SessionStart notice: a repo that committed the vendored checkers but whose clone has no core.hooksPath or diff.codegraph.textconv gets one line naming the install command. It only prints — git leaves .git/config out of a clone so that cloning cannot cause code to run, and wiring it automatically would route around that.
